comparison_coverage: PLB 855 (138806), PRC 110 (044304) and PRC 111 (014303), publisher versions with 8/12/11 PDF pages. The PLB PDF includes a repository cover. Publications reuse the thesis campaign. La and Cs use the 255 MeV acquisition and I the 275 MeV acquisition. The I synthesis also uses distinct earlier ORNL/GSI studies.
remaining: No source-located quantitative P plus angle joint solution established for a mixed E2/M1 transition. The delta=0 and delta=0.5 examples retain the method/control or illustrative status indicated on their pages.
The asymmetry conversion statement and the two printed numerators require a convention/calibration check before numerical reuse.
The 117Cs ground-state spin alternatives and the 114I prior-decay interpretation remain source-scoped. The latter uses inferential nanosecond scales.
